mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE rises above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and decreases in the unemployment rate indicate a tightening monetary policy amid strong labor market conditions, which typically triggers equity market corrections and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.3pp in 1 month AND UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 1 month
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market strength
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.3pp and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (above 1200 thousand units) reflect strong consumer demand for housing and related sectors, which boosts economic growth and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production index above 100 (relative to 2017 base) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which supports corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is above 100.

mechanism_narrative: An annualized inflation rate above 2.5% (as measured by CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strong retail sales growth (RSAFS rising) and rising federal funds rates indicate a robust economy with tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to equity market volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 0.5% in 1 month AND FEDFUNDS rises > 0.3pp in 1 month
regime_hint: strong retail sales with monetary tightening
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS rises > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.3pp in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 4.5% reflects a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%.
